description_en: Aśikharatemple from circa 13th-15th century at the Bhurtī Temple Complex.The monument is found in the southern part of the Bhurtī Temple Complex. The site itself is located in the northern end of the settlement of Bhurtī, 3 km north of Narayana, the district headquarters. It currently comprises 22 standingśikharatemples (ordevala) and one stone fountain. Architectural activity at the site can be situated between the 13thand 15thcentury, a time period corresponding to the latter part of the Khaśa Malla empire and the early phase of the Rāskoṭi dynasty (Andolfatto 2019,Pokharel 2011: 128-129,Sharma 1972: 23-31,Sharma 2012: 120-123).The monument is built on a recently made platform constituted of roughly cut stones and cement. It is oriented to the south, as for most of the temples at the site. The sanctum is currently empty. The tower was recently rebuilt, as is indicated by traces of cement between stone blocks. It still has its originalāmalakaring.A stone lion, probably contemporaneous to building activity at the site (13th-15th century) is found lying in the ground north of the temple. it may have been installed on top of a temple's pediment, or in front of a door. The statue evokes the almost identical sculptures placed on temples' pediments in Uttarakhand.In 2008, the “Bhurti Temple Complex of Dailekh” was included in UNESCO's World Heritage Tentative List.
description_ne: भुर्ती मन्दिर पसिरमा २२ शिखर मन्दिरहरू र एउटा ढुङ्गे धारा छन् । सन् २००८ मा यो मन्दिर परिसरलाई नेपाल सरकारले UNESCO’s World Heritage को ‘tentative list’ मा सूचीकृत गरेको थियो । यहाँ प्रस्तुत भुर्ती एक्ले देवल काटिएका ढुङ्गा र सिमेन्टि प्रयोग गरेर भर्खरै बनाइएको जगमाथि दक्षिणतिर फर्केर ठडिएको छ । यो मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा कुनै पनि देवदेवी स्थापना गरिएका छैनन् । ढुङ्गाको एउटा सिंह मन्दिरको उत्तरतर्फ भूमिमा लडिरहेको अबस्थामा छ र यो सिंह पनि मन्दिर बनाइएकै समय अर्थात ईशाको तेह्रौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीभित्रको हुनुपर्दछ हुनुपर्दछ तर यो कुरा पुष्टि गर्ने कुनै ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज भने उपलब्ध छैन । यो सिंह मन्दिर स्थापनाको समयमा ढोकामा द्वारपालको रूपमा राखिएको हुनुपर्दछ ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
